collection.default: enabled in supported production builds; user can disable in Settings
collection.identifier: random installation UUID; no account, advertising ID, or RevenueCat link
collection.transport: HTTPS to https://us.i.posthog.com; receiving server sees source IP; GeoIP enrichment disabled

proposedAdditionalTypes.linked: conservatively disclose as linked to an installation/device until the complete SDK data flow is reviewed

apple.tracking: No cross-company advertising measurement, data broker sharing, or advertising ID use is implemented by this change. Review the complete app and any provider integrations before submitting the Tracking answer.
apple.preserve: Keep existing RevenueCat purchase disclosures; this adds analytics disclosures.

plannedAnswers.reason: Conservative installation/device-linked disclosure for persistent PostHog installation UUID; not a claim that real names or accounts are collected.
RevenueCat anonymous IDs without a custom account identifier or a link to PostHog; follows the RevenueCat Apple privacy guide.

apple.publicationTiming: Apple says the questionnaire must reflect versions currently available on the store. PostHog fields were examined but not published in advance of the new version; incomplete inputs were canceled and the original live state was verified after reload.

google.collection: Data leaves the device; declare collection even though identifiers are random.
google.optional: An in-app setting can disable analytics without blocking features.
google.sharing: Evaluate the service-provider exception against the actual PostHog configuration/DPA; do not automatically label all processor transfers as sharing.
google.deletion: User copies Analytics ID from Settings and contacts support; operator must locate/delete matching PostHog events using that distinct_id. Turning analytics off alone does not delete remote history.

beforeRelease: Review the runtime payload on both native platforms, including SDK-added identifiers and receiving-server IP processing.

Update Apple App Privacy and Google Play Data safety for all active versions/SDKs.
Review the existing Play target-audience/Families declarations and analytics treatment before shipping to children.
Do not mark policyStatus reviewed solely because local tests passed.
